phase_intent: development base for Spark-Hermes-Glimmer-30B. Trained and scored in bf16 on a 96 GB card; distributed as GGUF sized for a 32 GB card, which is a separate artifact whose scores must be re-measured rather than inherited.
hermes_dialect_evidence: the repository's own chat_template.jinja renders tool calls as <atem:function_calls> / <atem:invoke name="..."> / <atem:parameter name="...">, returns results in <tool_output name="...">, and addresses deliberation to a `self` recipient rather than emitting an inline reasoning tag. It contains no <tool_call> and no <think>: this model does not speak Hermes, and hermes/atem.py exists because of that. Verified by generation, not only by reading -- see docs/serving-muse-glimmer.md.
dialect_note: The pinned artifact for this dialect is upstream's own chat_template.jinja, committed at hermes/templates/chat-template-atem.jinja, and hermes.conformance checks that every marker hermes/atem.py parses is still present in it. There is no rendered system prompt to pin because this repo writes no tool block for ATEM: the definitions go with the request so the template renders them, the valid-recipient list and the reasoning line as one consistent block.
serving: SGLang built from the upstream muse-glimmer branch. vLLM 0.27.0 has no native support for this architecture and its --model-impl transformers fallback returns incoherent output for it. scripts/serve_agent.sh carries the recipe; docs/serving-muse-glimmer.md carries the evidence and the eight startup failures behind it, none of which were the model.
text_config_note: Every text hyperparameter is nested under text_config. This is a MuseGlimmerForConditionalGeneration, so the top level of config.json carries only vision and projector keys -- anything reading it for hidden_size or num_hidden_layers gets None and computes a memory budget out of nothing. tests/test_base_model.py asserts the nesting for that reason. AutoModelForCausalLM also refuses this config outright; the class is AutoModelForImageTextToText.
kv_bytes_per_token_note: Over the 13 FULL-ATTENTION layers only: 2 * 13 * 2 kv_heads * 128 head_dim * 2 bytes. This model is hybrid -- layer_types is 39 sliding_attention + 13 full_attention -- and the 39 sliding layers hold at most `sliding_window` (2048) tokens each rather than growing with context, so they belong in a bounded per-sequence budget and not in a figure multiplied by a context length. Counting all 52 layers would give 53248 and overstate the per-token cost by 4x, which is how a card that runs this model comfortably gets ruled out on paper. Two KV heads is aggressive GQA and is most of why this figure is small for a 30B.
kv_bytes_measured_note: Not yet measured on this model. The previous pin carried a measured figure from vLLM 0.26.0 on an RTX PRO 6000; that number described Qwen3.6-27B and is not transferable, so it is null rather than carried over. Deriving it is arithmetic; measuring it needs a serving run that reports its KV pool, and SGLang's accounting has not been read yet.
